title: The Championship Dampener
logline: An aging zero-g athlete refuses to implant a mandatory neural dampener required by a new league safety code, risking permanent neurological damage to play their farewell championship series.

roles.description: A celebrated zero-g court athlete nearing the end of a legendary career; proud and terrified of playing with muted reflexes.
The sports physician tasked with certifying players under the league's new safety protocol; genuinely protective of player health.
Controls the team's arena lease; desperate to win the finals while avoiding catastrophic league liability penalties.
The pressurized spherical sports arena where zero-g flight games are contested.

public_situation: Ahead of the championship series at {system}'s orbital velodrome, the sports commission mandates neural dampeners to eliminate high-velocity concussion risks.
private_truth: The veteran striker has already suffered micro-strokes that the dampener would stabilize, but the implant's reaction lag would guarantee they lose their final championship title.

beats.public_change: League marshals arrive at the arena to conduct mandatory cranial scans on all starting flight athletes.

missions.reason: The doctor hires an outside courier to transport certified biometric testing cassettes directly to the locker clinic before the official pre-match inspection.
missions.private_fact: She has already warned the striker twice that another unmitigated match collision could cause irreversible motor paralysis.

beats.public_change: Rumors circulate that the striker's pre-match medical waiver was rejected by the safety board.

missions.reason: The striker contracts the pilot to retrieve their custom-tuned un-dampened flight harness from an off-station private locker before inspectors impound it.
missions.private_fact: He knows this is his last contract year and has wagered his entire retirement savings on the championship winner purse.

beats.public_change: The arena stands fill to capacity while the commissioner threatens to forfeit the match if the medical clearance is not finalized.

missions.reason: The owner contracts the pilot to deliver the final arbitration papers to the commissioner's box, demanding a decisive choice on player eligibility.
missions.private_fact: The owner holds a reinsurance bond that pays out twice as much if the match proceeds regardless of injury.

player_choice.prompt: The final medical dossier rests with the pilot before delivery to the commissioner. The pilot must choose which certification to register.

options.label: Deliver the medical disqualification, forcing the athlete to install the dampener
Deliver the unrestricted emergency waiver, allowing the striker to play un-dampened
Submit the reinsurance fraud report, cancelling the match entirely

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot submits the mandatory safety ruling, forcing the dampener implant.
resolutions.summary: {role:veteran_striker} plays with the neural dampener and loses the match, but retains their health. {role:team_physician} validates the safety protocol.

consequences.public_summary: A courier delivered the medical ruling that benched an aging star's reflexes for their own protection.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot submits the unrestricted waiver, letting the striker play without dampening.
resolutions.summary: {role:veteran_striker} secures the championship victory but collapses from severe motor trauma. {role:franchise_owner} collects the purse.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot delivered the waiver that let a sports legend fly one last un-dampened match to ruin.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot exposes the reinsurance fraud, voiding the final match.
resolutions.summary: The championship match is cancelled amidst scandal. {role:franchise_owner} faces regulatory prosecution, while {role:veteran_striker} retires in disgrace.

consequences.public_summary: A courier exposed owner liability schemes, cancelling the velodrome championship final.

resolutions.summary: The certification deadline expires without filing. {role:veteran_striker} is benched automatically, the arena riots, and {role:franchise_owner} incurs massive venue breach fines.

loose_threads.detail: The velodrome betting syndicate shifted the championship underdog odds thirty minutes before the neural dampener mandate was announced.
The serial imprint on the neural dampener cases matches a shipment ordered by a private sanatorium in a neighboring system.

radio_hooks: Zero-g flight commission imposes mandatory cranial dampener rule ahead of velodrome finals.
Fans stage demonstrations outside franchise offices demanding star striker be cleared to fly.
Sports arbiters debate player autonomy versus catastrophic league medical liability in {system}.

voice_direction.veteran_striker: Raspy, proud, and speaks with dismissive bravado to mask tremors. Never admits how much his vision is blurring.
voice_direction.team_physician: Clinical, calm, but speaks with clipped urgency when ignored. Refuses to discuss the financial stakes of the match.
voice_direction.franchise_owner: Fast-talking, theatrical, and constantly flatters listeners. Avoids looking directly at the medical monitors.
